description.de: Die Protagonistin der Geschichte, die ein riesiger Fan von Animes ist, stirbt leider auf tragische Weise durch einen Fehler der Göttin. Als die Göttin ihr sagt, sie werde sie an den Ort senden, den sie sich wünscht, bittet die Protagonistin ohne zu zögern darum, sofort in die Welt ihres allerliebsten Charakters wiedergeboren zu werden. Doch sie wird ausgerechnet als eine grausame Prinzessin wiedergeboren, die ihren Lieblingscharakter quält. Trotzdem versucht sie alles zu tun, um den Tod ihres liebsten Charakters zu verhindern und um ihm einen guten Weg zu bereiten.
description.en:
Agnes Saint is a princess with a reputation for cruelty and an unhealthy obsession with the dashing Captain Raymond. But when her personality changes overnight, it baffles everyone around her. The secret? The soul of a fangirl replaced Agnes in the middle of the story. Now, fueled by a stan’s unslakable love, she’s turned her eye to Kylo Grey, a side character with humble origins and her number one bias. Can she rewrite Agnes’ story to ship herself with the man of her dreams?
___
I’ve been reincarnated into a novel with my living and breathing bias.
Now I’m an Imperial Princess, who is known by all sorts of epithets, Agnes Saint!

It’s great that she’s filthy rich and a royal and all, but there’s just one problem…
the hateful trash who just insulted by bias’s very existence is none other than ‘me.’

Regardless, I’m here now and…
I will do anything, and everything, within my power to prevent my bias’s death and ensure he experiences nothing but smooth sailing going forward!

I would never wish for Kylo, my kitten, to suffer any sort of shock.
That’s why I have to hide my fervent adoration.
Besides, nothing good would come from revealing my stanning anyways.
So, for the time being, I’ll be perfect at… 

‘stanning in secret.’
description.es: Una ávida lectora de la novela “Splash infinito” muere atropellada por un “error de sistema”, según le informa una diosa. Para compensarla por el pequeño descuido, le ofrece una nueva vida en cualquier mundo que ella desee, real o ficticio. Sin pensarlo dos veces, la lectora sabe exactamente lo que quiere: conocer a su personaje favorito de “Splash infinito”, Kylo Grey. Pero, obviamente, renace como el personaje que peor relación tiene con Kylo, la princesa Agnes Saint. Para colmo, Agnes tiene una reputación espantosa en todo el imperio. Nuestra lectora tiene un doble desafío frente a ella: rectificar su mala fama de a poco para no levantar sospechas y, además, hacer todo lo posible para mejorar su relación con Kylo y vivir el tórrido romance que siempre se ha imaginado. ¿Lo logrará?
description.fr: Agnès Saint est une princesse connue pour sa cruauté et son obsession maladive pour le fringant Capitaine Raymond. Mais lorsqu’elle change soudainement de personnalité du jour au lendemain, tout le monde autour d’elle est déconcerté. Son secret ? L’âme d’une fangirl a pris la place d’Agnès en plein milieu de l’histoire. Désormais guidée par un amour inébranlable de fan, elle jette son dévolu sur Kaylo, un personnage secondaire aux origines modestes et son coup de cœur ultime. Parviendra-t-elle à réécrire l’histoire d’Agnès pour se mettre en couple avec l’homme de ses rêves ?
description.id: Seorang fangirl garis keras karakter villain bernama Kylo Gray masuk ke cerita yang disukainya! Namun, saat tersadar, kenapa dia malah menampar Kylo? Terlebih, berkali-kali?! Ternyata dia terlahir kembali sebagai karakter yang membenci Kylo, Agnes Saint. Apa yang akan dilakukan fans nomor satu Kylo ini pada takdir barunya?
description.ko:
최애가 살아 숨 쉬는 소설로 환생했다.
각종 수식어로 불리는 제국의 황녀, 아그네스 세인트로!

일단 돈 많은 황족인 건 좋은데...
최애의 인격을 모독하던 혐성 쓰레기가 바로 '나'라는 게 문제였다.

그래도 이왕 이렇게 된 이상...
기필코, 반드시, 어떻게 해서든 최애의 죽음을 막고 그 앞에 꽃길을 깔아주겠다!

나만의 아기 고양이, 카일로가 놀라는 건 결코 원하지 않았다.
그러려면 이 애끓는 마음을 당분간은 숨겨야만 한다.
게다가 원래 덕질을 밝혀서 좋은 건 없다. 그러니 당분간은 완벽하게...

'일코'한다.
description.ru:
Переродиться в романе, где живет мой любимый персонаж.
Самая красивая женщина континента. Любимая драгоценность императора. Королева светского общества. Бомба замедленного действия.
Я стала принцессой Агнес Сеинт, которую и называют всеми этими титулами и именами. Приятно быть частью богатой королевской семьи, но…
Как Драко Малфой, презирающий магглов в Гарри Поттере, так и «я» была ненормальной стервой, которая оскорбила моего любимого персонажа. И что еще хуже — она безнадежно влюблена в другого мужчину.
«Мой любимчик — Кайл, соперник главного героя, чьей ненормальной фанаткой я и переродилась…»
Но теперь, когда все в моих руках… Я любой ценой, любыми способами предотвращу смерть моего любимого персонажа и застелю его путь цветами! Но если бы я вдруг раскрыла себя как фанатка Кайла, все бы решили, что я сошла с ума. Он бы посчитал, что я чокнутая! Я вовсе не хочу, чтобы мой котенок был так шокирован. Поэтому пока что я должна скрывать свою мучительную привязанность. Тем более, что раскрытие того, что вы фанат, никогда не заканчивается ничем хорошим. Поэтому на данный момент идеально будет… «Держать все в тайне».

description.en: In Platter City, where the Oven Crown Cup has turned the streets into chaos, the Fixers from Café Fruit Bomber take on a tricky job: recovering a valuable stolen treasure. But what seemed like a simple task soon leads them to the city's biggest competition, where they'll have to navigate rivals, challenges, and all sorts of unexpected events to complete their mission.
description.es: En Platter City, donde la Oven Crown Cup llena las calles de caos, los Fixers del Café Fruit Bomber aceptan un trabajo complicado: recuperar un valioso tesoro robado. Pero lo que parecía un simple trabajo pronto los llevará a la gran competición de la ciudad, donde tendrán que abrirse paso entre rivales, desafíos y toda clase de imprevistos para cumplir su encargo.

altTitles.en: My Dragon Girlfriend Has Returned
Return of the Dragon Girlfriend

description.ar:
في عالم تظهر فيه البوابات فجاة وتخرج منها الوحوش، يعيش الصياد يون مينجون مثقلا بالذنب بعد وفاة حبيبته جونغ سيا في حادثة اختراق بوابة.

وبعد عام كامل من موتها، وفي ذكرى وفاتها، تحدث كارثة جديدة عند قبرها… لكن ما يخرج من البوابة هذه المرة ليس وحشا، بل سيا نفسها.

لقد عادت حبيبته التي ظن انها ماتت، لكن ليس كما كانت؛ فقد اصبحت تنينا، اقوى كائن حي، وبعد ان قضت زمنا طويلا تبحث عن وسيلة للعودة اليه، لم يعد يشغلها سوى شيء واحد: البقاء الى جانب مينجون… والتاكد من انه لم يجد حبيبة اخرى في غيابها.
description.en:
In a world where gates suddenly appear and monsters emerge from them, hunter Yoon Min-jun lives burdened by guilt after losing his girlfriend, Jung Si-a, in a gate break incident.

One year after her death, on the anniversary of the tragedy, another disaster occurs at her grave… but this time, what emerges from the gate is not a monster.

It is Si-a herself.

The girlfriend he thought was dead has returned, but no longer as the person he once knew. She has become a dragon, the strongest living creature, and after spending an unimaginably long time searching for a way back to him, she now wants only one thing: to stay by Min-jun’s side… and make sure he did not find another girlfriend while she was gone.

Twenty-four-year-old job seeker 'Im Yooha' returns to her parents' house in tears after a series of job rejections following her college graduation. There, she encounters 'Ji Mingyu' the youngest son of the homeowners and the black sheep of the family.

At their first meeting, he rudely asks, "Are you the new helper who moved in today?" and behaves disrespectfully. Under the same roof with the immature young master she never wanted to get involved with, ro...mance? Absolutely not! Let's keep the line we should never cross between you and me.

altTitles.es-la: ¿Por qué estás tan obsesionado conmigo incluso cuando estoy muerta?

altTitles.en: Even When I'm Dead
Why Are You Obsessed? Even Though You're Dead

description.en: On the day of my wedding, I found out that my lover was cheating on me with my best friend. I died because of their betrayal, and when I opened my eyes again, I returned to the past. I thought this was a blessing from God, a chance to take revenge. But this return was neverending as I kept dying either from their betrayal or in an accident. After my repeated death, I realized that accidents did not cause all of my deaths but that I was being murdered. So this time, I faked my death and left everything behind to catch the murderer, who was killing me repeatedly and to take my revenge finally.
description.ko:

title.en: The Youngest Is Trying to Prevent the World From Ending

altTitles.en: The Youngest Is Preventing the End of the World
The Youngest Child of the Family Is Preventing the World From Ending

altTitles.ja: 末っ子悪女、世界滅亡を阻止します！

description.en:
After hitting my head, I remembered my past life and realized I was in a novel. Ugh, why do I have to be Diana Cartier, the bratty child brainwashed to do evil deeds and destroy the world?! I won’t let that happen. I’ll stop the end of the world with my own hands and save my brothers! Wait, why is the novel’s protagonist lying on the street? And oh, aren’t those animals so cute? Make way for the cute youngest who’s trying to save the world!
____
"The stupid youngest one, the one who doesn't know how to do anything, but causes trouble with her cute face."

Exasperated, I looked in the mirror once again and exclaimed, "Why am I the 'stupid youngest one' Diana Cartier!"

In the novel *The Ending Can't Be the Destruction of the World*, Diana is an evil woman who repeatedly commits evil deeds and is brainwashed by the villain, contributing greatly to the destruction of the world! If something could go wrong for the villainess, it will. But when something went wrong for me, I recalled my past life instead? As an ordinary college student in my past life, I made up my mind when I realized that I had been reincarnated as Diana Cartier, the villainess in the novel.

"The world is going to end. But I'm not going to let it happen."

Yes, I will prevent the end of the world with my own hands! And save my brothers from the conspiracy at the same time! Wait a minute. What's that pitch black thing sprawled out on the floor over there? Wait. That face, where have I seen it before? 

'Is that Linus del Stein?!'

Why are you lying there, Mr. Protagonist of the novel who will destroy this world?

Diana and her brothers are trying their best to stop the end of the world! And cute animals and other stuff? Our sweet youngest is preventing the end of the world, get out of the way!
description.fr:
«La plus jeune et sotte, celle qui ne sait rien faire, mais qui cause des ennuis avec son joli minois.»

Exaspérée, je me suis à nouveau regardée dans le miroir et je me suis exclamée, «Pourquoi suis-je la 'plus jeune stupide' Diana Cartier!»

Dans le roman *Le fin ne peut pas la destruction du monde*, Diana est une femme maléfique qui commet des actes néfastes à répétition et subit un lavage de cerveau de la part du méchant, ce qui contribue grandement à la destruction du monde! Si quelque chose peut mal tourner pour la méchante, cela se produira. Mais quand quelque chose tourne mal pour moi, je me souviens plutôt de ma vie passée? J'étais une étudiante ordinaire dans ma vie passée, et j'ai pris ma décision lorsque j'ai réalisé que j'avais été réincarnée en Diana Cartier, la méchante du roman.

«Le monde va s'écrouler. Mais je ne vais pas laisser faire.»

Oui, je vais empêcher la fin du monde de mes propres mains! Et sauver mes frères de la conspiration en même temps! Attendez un peu. Qu'est-ce que c'est que cette chose noire sur le sol là-bas? Attendez. Ce visage, où l'ai-je déjà vu?

‹Est-ce Linus del Stein?!›

Pourquoi êtes-vous allongé là, Monsieur le Protagoniste du roman qui va détruire ce monde?

Diana et ses frères font de leur mieux pour empêcher la fin du monde! Et des animaux mignons et d'autres choses? Notre adorable petit dernier est en train d'empêcher la fin du monde, pousse-toi de là!
description.ko:
#원작환생, #영지물 #악녀였던 여주, #여주한테만착한오빠들, #여주한테만순한남자주인공, #사이다 전개, #약간의 착각물

“할 줄 아는 건 아무 것도 없으면서 귀여운 얼굴만 믿고 폐를 끼치는 멍청한 막내, 걔.”

분개한 나는 다시 한 번 거울을 보고 외쳤다.

“왜 내가 하필 '멍청한 막내, 걔' 디아나 카르티에인 거야!?”

「결말이 세계 멸망일리 없어」 라는 소설에서 악행을 거듭하다가 악당에게 세뇌당해서 세계 멸망에 크게 일조하는 악녀, 디아나!
악녀는 뒤로 넘어져도 코가 깨진다더니, 나는 뒤로 넘어졌는데 전생을 기억해냈다?

전생에서 평범한 대학생이었던 나는 자신이 소설 속 악녀, 디아나 카르티에로 환생한 것을 깨닫고 마음을 먹었다.


“이 세상은 망할 거야.”
“하지만 내가 그렇게 두지 않을 거야.”

그래, 세계 멸망은 내 손으로 막아내겠어!
겸사겸사 오빠들도 음모에서 구하고!

잠깐. 저기 바닥에 널브러진 새카만 저건 뭐야?
잠깐.
저 얼굴, 어디서 분명 봤는데?

‘혹시 라이너스 델 슈타인!?’

당신이 왜 거기 쓰러져 있죠, 이 세상을 멸망 시키는 소설의 주인공 씨?

열심히 세계 멸망을 막으려 애를 쓰는 디아나와 오빠들!
그리고 귀여운 동물과 기타 등등?

우리 뽀짝 막내가 세계멸망을 막는 중이다, 길을 비켜라!

“할 줄 아는 건 아무 것도 없으면서 귀여운 얼굴만 믿고 폐를 끼치는 멍청한 막내, 걔.”

우리 뽀짝 막내가 세계멸망을 막는 중이다, 길을 비켜라!

altTitles.ja: 末っ子悪女、世界滅亡を阻止します！

description.en:
After hitting my head, I remembered my past life and realized I was in a novel. Ugh, why do I have to be Diana Cartier, the bratty child brainwashed to do evil deeds and destroy the world?! I won’t let that happen. I’ll stop the end of the world with my own hands and save my brothers! Wait, why is the novel’s protagonist lying on the street? And oh, aren’t those animals so cute? Make way for the cute youngest who’s trying to save the world!
____
"The stupid youngest one, the one who doesn't know how to do anything, but causes trouble with her cute face."

Exasperated, I looked in the mirror once again and exclaimed, "Why am I the 'stupid youngest one' Diana Cartier!"

In the novel *The Ending Can't Be the Destruction of the World*, Diana is an evil woman who repeatedly commits evil deeds and is brainwashed by the villain, contributing greatly to the destruction of the world! If something could go wrong for the villainess, it will. But when something went wrong for me, I recalled my past life instead? As an ordinary college student in my past life, I made up my mind when I realized that I had been reincarnated as Diana Cartier, the villainess in the novel.

"The world is going to end. But I'm not going to let it happen."

Yes, I will prevent the end of the world with my own hands! And save my brothers from the conspiracy at the same time! Wait a minute. What's that pitch black thing sprawled out on the floor over there? Wait. That face, where have I seen it before? 

'Is that Linus del Stein?!'

Why are you lying there, Mr. Protagonist of the novel who will destroy this world?

Diana and her brothers are trying their best to stop the end of the world! And cute animals and other stuff? Our sweet youngest is preventing the end of the world, get out of the way!
description.fr:
«La plus jeune et sotte, celle qui ne sait rien faire, mais qui cause des ennuis avec son joli minois.»

Exaspérée, je me suis à nouveau regardée dans le miroir et je me suis exclamée, «Pourquoi suis-je la 'plus jeune stupide' Diana Cartier!»

“할 줄 아는 건 아무 것도 없으면서 귀여운 얼굴만 믿고 폐를 끼치는 멍청한 막내, 걔.”

우리 뽀짝 막내가 세계멸망을 막는 중이다, 길을 비켜라!

altTitles.ja: 末っ子悪女、世界滅亡を阻止します！

description.en:
After hitting my head, I remembered my past life and realized I was in a novel. Ugh, why do I have to be Diana Cartier, the bratty child brainwashed to do evil deeds and destroy the world?! I won’t let that happen. I’ll stop the end of the world with my own hands and save my brothers! Wait, why is the novel’s protagonist lying on the street? And oh, aren’t those animals so cute? Make way for the cute youngest who’s trying to save the world!
____
"The stupid youngest one, the one who doesn't know how to do anything, but causes trouble with her cute face."

Exasperated, I looked in the mirror once again and exclaimed, "Why am I the 'stupid youngest one' Diana Cartier!"

In the novel *The Ending Can't Be the Destruction of the World*, Diana is an evil woman who repeatedly commits evil deeds and is brainwashed by the villain, contributing greatly to the destruction of the world! If something could go wrong for the villainess, it will. But when something went wrong for me, I recalled my past life instead? As an ordinary college student in my past life, I made up my mind when I realized that I had been reincarnated as Diana Cartier, the villainess in the novel.

"The world is going to end. But I'm not going to let it happen."

Yes, I will prevent the end of the world with my own hands! And save my brothers from the conspiracy at the same time! Wait a minute. What's that pitch black thing sprawled out on the floor over there? Wait. That face, where have I seen it before? 

'Is that Linus del Stein?!'

Why are you lying there, Mr. Protagonist of the novel who will destroy this world?

Diana and her brothers are trying their best to stop the end of the world! And cute animals and other stuff? Our sweet youngest is preventing the end of the world, get out of the way!
description.fr:
«La plus jeune et sotte, celle qui ne sait rien faire, mais qui cause des ennuis avec son joli minois.»

Exaspérée, je me suis à nouveau regardée dans le miroir et je me suis exclamée, «Pourquoi suis-je la 'plus jeune stupide' Diana Cartier!»

“할 줄 아는 건 아무 것도 없으면서 귀여운 얼굴만 믿고 폐를 끼치는 멍청한 막내, 걔.”

우리 뽀짝 막내가 세계멸망을 막는 중이다, 길을 비켜라!

altTitles.ja: 末っ子悪女、世界滅亡を阻止します！

description.en:
After hitting my head, I remembered my past life and realized I was in a novel. Ugh, why do I have to be Diana Cartier, the bratty child brainwashed to do evil deeds and destroy the world?! I won’t let that happen. I’ll stop the end of the world with my own hands and save my brothers! Wait, why is the novel’s protagonist lying on the street? And oh, aren’t those animals so cute? Make way for the cute youngest who’s trying to save the world!
____
"The stupid youngest one, the one who doesn't know how to do anything, but causes trouble with her cute face."

Exasperated, I looked in the mirror once again and exclaimed, "Why am I the 'stupid youngest one' Diana Cartier!"

In the novel *The Ending Can't Be the Destruction of the World*, Diana is an evil woman who repeatedly commits evil deeds and is brainwashed by the villain, contributing greatly to the destruction of the world! If something could go wrong for the villainess, it will. But when something went wrong for me, I recalled my past life instead? As an ordinary college student in my past life, I made up my mind when I realized that I had been reincarnated as Diana Cartier, the villainess in the novel.

"The world is going to end. But I'm not going to let it happen."

Yes, I will prevent the end of the world with my own hands! And save my brothers from the conspiracy at the same time! Wait a minute. What's that pitch black thing sprawled out on the floor over there? Wait. That face, where have I seen it before? 

'Is that Linus del Stein?!'

Why are you lying there, Mr. Protagonist of the novel who will destroy this world?

Diana and her brothers are trying their best to stop the end of the world! And cute animals and other stuff? Our sweet youngest is preventing the end of the world, get out of the way!
description.fr:
«La plus jeune et sotte, celle qui ne sait rien faire, mais qui cause des ennuis avec son joli minois.»

Exaspérée, je me suis à nouveau regardée dans le miroir et je me suis exclamée, «Pourquoi suis-je la 'plus jeune stupide' Diana Cartier!»

“할 줄 아는 건 아무 것도 없으면서 귀여운 얼굴만 믿고 폐를 끼치는 멍청한 막내, 걔.”

우리 뽀짝 막내가 세계멸망을 막는 중이다, 길을 비켜라!

altTitles.ja: 末っ子悪女、世界滅亡を阻止します！

description.en:
After hitting my head, I remembered my past life and realized I was in a novel. Ugh, why do I have to be Diana Cartier, the bratty child brainwashed to do evil deeds and destroy the world?! I won’t let that happen. I’ll stop the end of the world with my own hands and save my brothers! Wait, why is the novel’s protagonist lying on the street? And oh, aren’t those animals so cute? Make way for the cute youngest who’s trying to save the world!
____
"The stupid youngest one, the one who doesn't know how to do anything, but causes trouble with her cute face."

Exasperated, I looked in the mirror once again and exclaimed, "Why am I the 'stupid youngest one' Diana Cartier!"

In the novel *The Ending Can't Be the Destruction of the World*, Diana is an evil woman who repeatedly commits evil deeds and is brainwashed by the villain, contributing greatly to the destruction of the world! If something could go wrong for the villainess, it will. But when something went wrong for me, I recalled my past life instead? As an ordinary college student in my past life, I made up my mind when I realized that I had been reincarnated as Diana Cartier, the villainess in the novel.

"The world is going to end. But I'm not going to let it happen."

Yes, I will prevent the end of the world with my own hands! And save my brothers from the conspiracy at the same time! Wait a minute. What's that pitch black thing sprawled out on the floor over there? Wait. That face, where have I seen it before? 

'Is that Linus del Stein?!'

Why are you lying there, Mr. Protagonist of the novel who will destroy this world?

Diana and her brothers are trying their best to stop the end of the world! And cute animals and other stuff? Our sweet youngest is preventing the end of the world, get out of the way!
description.fr:
«La plus jeune et sotte, celle qui ne sait rien faire, mais qui cause des ennuis avec son joli minois.»

Exaspérée, je me suis à nouveau regardée dans le miroir et je me suis exclamée, «Pourquoi suis-je la 'plus jeune stupide' Diana Cartier!»

title.en: The Youngest Is Trying to Prevent the World From Ending

altTitles.en: The Youngest Is Preventing the End of the World
The Youngest Child of the Family Is Preventing the World From Ending

altTitles.ja: 末っ子悪女、世界滅亡を阻止します！

description.en:
After hitting my head, I remembered my past life and realized I was in a novel. Ugh, why do I have to be Diana Cartier, the bratty child brainwashed to do evil deeds and destroy the world?! I won’t let that happen. I’ll stop the end of the world with my own hands and save my brothers! Wait, why is the novel’s protagonist lying on the street? And oh, aren’t those animals so cute? Make way for the cute youngest who’s trying to save the world!
____
"The stupid youngest one, the one who doesn't know how to do anything, but causes trouble with her cute face."

Exasperated, I looked in the mirror once again and exclaimed, "Why am I the 'stupid youngest one' Diana Cartier!"

In the novel *The Ending Can't Be the Destruction of the World*, Diana is an evil woman who repeatedly commits evil deeds and is brainwashed by the villain, contributing greatly to the destruction of the world! If something could go wrong for the villainess, it will. But when something went wrong for me, I recalled my past life instead? As an ordinary college student in my past life, I made up my mind when I realized that I had been reincarnated as Diana Cartier, the villainess in the novel.

"The world is going to end. But I'm not going to let it happen."

Yes, I will prevent the end of the world with my own hands! And save my brothers from the conspiracy at the same time! Wait a minute. What's that pitch black thing sprawled out on the floor over there? Wait. That face, where have I seen it before? 

'Is that Linus del Stein?!'

Why are you lying there, Mr. Protagonist of the novel who will destroy this world?

Diana and her brothers are trying their best to stop the end of the world! And cute animals and other stuff? Our sweet youngest is preventing the end of the world, get out of the way!
description.fr:
«La plus jeune et sotte, celle qui ne sait rien faire, mais qui cause des ennuis avec son joli minois.»

Exaspérée, je me suis à nouveau regardée dans le miroir et je me suis exclamée, «Pourquoi suis-je la 'plus jeune stupide' Diana Cartier!»

Dans le roman *Le fin ne peut pas la destruction du monde*, Diana est une femme maléfique qui commet des actes néfastes à répétition et subit un lavage de cerveau de la part du méchant, ce qui contribue grandement à la destruction du monde! Si quelque chose peut mal tourner pour la méchante, cela se produira. Mais quand quelque chose tourne mal pour moi, je me souviens plutôt de ma vie passée? J'étais une étudiante ordinaire dans ma vie passée, et j'ai pris ma décision lorsque j'ai réalisé que j'avais été réincarnée en Diana Cartier, la méchante du roman.

«Le monde va s'écrouler. Mais je ne vais pas laisser faire.»

Oui, je vais empêcher la fin du monde de mes propres mains! Et sauver mes frères de la conspiration en même temps! Attendez un peu. Qu'est-ce que c'est que cette chose noire sur le sol là-bas? Attendez. Ce visage, où l'ai-je déjà vu?

Diana et ses frères font de leur mieux pour empêcher la fin du monde! Et des animaux mignons et d'autres choses? Notre adorable petit dernier est en train d'empêcher la fin du monde, pousse-toi de là!

altTitles.fr: L'héritière de la secte Tang protège sa famille

altTitles.en: The Eldest Daughter Protects the Tang Clan
The Eldest Daughter of the Tang Clan of Sacheon Protects the Family

description.en: Betrayed by her husband and forced to watch her family perish, Sohwa Tang, the brilliant Master of Poisons, exacts ruthless revenge before taking her own life. But death isn't the end. Awakening as her 17-year-old self, she makes a fierce vow: protect the Sichuan Tang clan at any cost. She doesn’t care about righteous justice or martial world politics. Her only goal is her family's survival. Yet as she brutally eliminates future threats, the world misinterprets her ruthless pragmatism as noble acts of chivalry. Follow Sohwa as she accidentally becomes the martial world’s greatest heroine while simply trying to keep her family alive.
description.fr: Tang So-hwa est une génie du poison qui connaît absolument tous les poisons existants sous le ciel, surnommée le "Maître de la Dissolution de Tous les Poisons" (Mandokhaesa). À la suite de la trahison de son mari — le chef de la famille/secte Namgoong —, sa propre famille est totalement exterminée. Seule survivante, So-hwa massacre la secte Namgoong à l'aide du poison avant de se suicider. Mais à peine a-t-elle fermé les yeux, après avoir accompli cette vengeance tant espérée, qu'elle les rouvre pour s'apercevoir qu'elle est revenue à ses 17 ans, à l'âge d'or de la secte Tang de Sichuan... ?!

description.fr:
Judith se réveille un jour pour découvrir qu’elle est devenue, du jour au lendemain, une baronne criblée de dettes suite au décès de son père – puis elle se rend compte qu’elle s’est réincarnée dans un roman qu’elle avait lu dans sa vie antérieure. Décidant de mettre à profit sa connaissance de l’intrigue originale pour rembourser ses dettes, elle entre au service de la maison du duc en tant que belle-fille sous contrat, se faisant passer pour la fausse épouse du fils disparu de la famille. Rembourser les dettes, profiter des luxes qu’elle ne pourrait jamais s’offrir dans sa vie réelle… Ce n’est que pour quelques mois, alors pourquoi ne pas en profiter au maximum ? Mais voilà que le mari, qui, dans le roman original, ne revient jamais, revient.

« Alors vous êtes ma femme. Celle qui porte mon enfant. »

La fuga de la hija del villano

altTitles.zh-hk: 反派的女儿打算离家出走

description.de: Nach 99 Leben als ‚Profi-Extra' erhält die unschuldig hingerichtete Herzogstochter Billicia eine besondere Macht: Regression! In ihrem 100. Leben will sie aber nicht fliehen, sondern das eisige Herz ihres gefürchteten Vaters erwärmen. Was kann da schon passieren...?
description.en:
I'll make my evil dad good and survive this time!
I was killed for being the villain's daughter, but when I opened my eyes, I was 14 years back in time. Too young and penniless, I decided to wait to escape... But why should I have to run away?! What if I train my dad to be good instead?
description.es:
¡Reformaré a mi malvado padre para sobrevivir!
Me ejecutaron por ser la hija del villano. Creí que ahí terminaría mi vida, pero regresé en el tiempo a mi infancia. Sin dinero y sin fuerzas, decidí esperar a ser más grande para escapar de mi trágico destino. Aunque… ¿no sería mejor si purifico el oscuro corazón de mi padre en lugar de huir?
description.fr: Vilisa est la fille de Kasys Valois, le vilain de l’empire Rolls. Raison suffisante pour être condamnée à mort et exécutée par l’empereur. Mais lorsqu’elle rouvre les yeux, quatorze ans plus tôt, elle se retrouve face à l’événement qui a fait basculer son père dans la folie. Deux choix s’offrent à elle: s’enfuir avant de se retrouver sur l’échafaud ou rester et tenter d’apaiser le chagrin de Kasys. Mais quelles sont ses chances de transformer le vilain en papa poule?
description.it: Renderò buono il mio cattivo padre e sopravviverò questa volta! Sono stata uccisa perché ero la figlia del cattivo, ma quando ho aperto gli occhi, ero tornata indietro di 14 anni nel tempo. Troppo giovane e senza un soldo, ho deciso di aspettare per scappare... Ma perché dovrei scappare?! E se invece alleno mio padre a essere buono?
description.ko:
악역의 딸이라는 이유로 사형당했다.

‘이놈들아, 난 아무것도 안 했다고!’

억울해하며 눈을 뜨니 14년 전으로 돌아왔다.
아직 악역 가문의 보살핌이 필요한 나는 용돈을 모아 탈출하기로 계획했는데…

“죽이면 끝나는 거 아닌가. 골치 아프게 협상을 왜….”
“협상하는 아빠 조아.”
“협상하도록 하지.”

무려 인생 2회차. 금수저가 탈출을 왜 해!?
아빠를 조련해 착한 사람으로 만들었다.

히히. 세상 사람들.
이제 우리 아빠 악역 아니거든요!



아하, 샌드위치 만들다가 그런 거구나.
그럼 그럼!

우리 아빠는 이제 착해졌다구요!
description.th: ฉันจะทำให้คุณพ่อกลายเป็นคนดีและมีชีวิตรอดไปให้ได้! ฉันถูกฆ่าด้วยเหตุผลเพียงเพราะเป็นลูกสาวของคนร้าย พอฉันลืมตาตื่นขึ้นมาอีกครั้ง กลับพบว่าตัวเองย้อนกลับมาเมื่อ 14 ปีก่อน ที่ทั้งเด็กเกินไปและไม่มีเงินติดตัวเลยสักนิด ฉันเลยตัดสินใจที่จะรอสักพักก่อนจะหนี… แต่ทำไมฉันต้องหนีด้วยล่ะ? ในเมื่อฉันสามารถฝึกคุณพ่อให้เป็นคนดีได้นี่?
description.pt-br:
"Depois de 100 vidas como a filha do vilão, tudo o que quero é um final feliz."

Na minha 99ª vida, fui executada só por ser a filha do vilão. Quando voltei a abrir os olhos, percebi que tinha voltado 14 anos no tempo e que estava de volta sob os cuidados da família do vilão. Por causa disso, decidi que precisava juntar dinheiro para fugir. Mas e se eu conseguisse convencer meu pai a não ser mais um vilão e virar uma pessoa legal...?

¡Reformaré a mi malvado padre para sobrevivir!
Me ejecutaron por ser la hija del villano. Creí que ahí terminaría mi vida, pero regresé en el tiempo a mi infancia. Sin dinero y sin fuerzas, decidí esperar a ser más grande para escapar de mi trágico destino. Aunque… ¿no sería mejor si purifico el oscuro corazón de mi padre en lugar de huir?
description.fr: Vilisa est la fille de Kasys Valois, le vilain de l’empire Rolls. Raison suffisante pour être condamnée à mort et exécutée par l’empereur. Mais lorsqu’elle rouvre les yeux, quatorze ans plus tôt, elle se retrouve face à l’événement qui a fait basculer son père dans la folie. Deux choix s’offrent à elle: s’enfuir avant de se retrouver sur l’échafaud ou rester et tenter d’apaiser le chagrin de Kasys. Mais quelles sont ses chances de transformer le vilain en papa poule?
description.it: Renderò buono il mio cattivo padre e sopravviverò questa volta! Sono stata uccisa perché ero la figlia del cattivo, ma quando ho aperto gli occhi, ero tornata indietro di 14 anni nel tempo. Troppo giovane e senza un soldo, ho deciso di aspettare per scappare... Ma perché dovrei scappare?! E se invece alleno mio padre a essere buono?
description.ko:
악역의 딸이라는 이유로 사형당했다.

‘이놈들아, 난 아무것도 안 했다고!’

억울해하며 눈을 뜨니 14년 전으로 돌아왔다.
아직 악역 가문의 보살핌이 필요한 나는 용돈을 모아 탈출하기로 계획했는데…

“죽이면 끝나는 거 아닌가. 골치 아프게 협상을 왜….”
“협상하는 아빠 조아.”
“협상하도록 하지.”

무려 인생 2회차. 금수저가 탈출을 왜 해!?
아빠를 조련해 착한 사람으로 만들었다.

히히. 세상 사람들.
이제 우리 아빠 악역 아니거든요!



아하, 샌드위치 만들다가 그런 거구나.
그럼 그럼!

우리 아빠는 이제 착해졌다구요!
description.th: ฉันจะทำให้คุณพ่อกลายเป็นคนดีและมีชีวิตรอดไปให้ได้! ฉันถูกฆ่าด้วยเหตุผลเพียงเพราะเป็นลูกสาวของคนร้าย พอฉันลืมตาตื่นขึ้นมาอีกครั้ง กลับพบว่าตัวเองย้อนกลับมาเมื่อ 14 ปีก่อน ที่ทั้งเด็กเกินไปและไม่มีเงินติดตัวเลยสักนิด ฉันเลยตัดสินใจที่จะรอสักพักก่อนจะหนี… แต่ทำไมฉันต้องหนีด้วยล่ะ? ในเมื่อฉันสามารถฝึกคุณพ่อให้เป็นคนดีได้นี่?
description.pt-br:
"Depois de 100 vidas como a filha do vilão, tudo o que quero é um final feliz."

Na minha 99ª vida, fui executada só por ser a filha do vilão. Quando voltei a abrir os olhos, percebi que tinha voltado 14 anos no tempo e que estava de volta sob os cuidados da família do vilão. Por causa disso, decidi que precisava juntar dinheiro para fugir. Mas e se eu conseguisse convencer meu pai a não ser mais um vilão e virar uma pessoa legal...?

description.de: Nach 99 Leben als ‚Profi-Extra' erhält die unschuldig hingerichtete Herzogstochter Billicia eine besondere Macht: Regression! In ihrem 100. Leben will sie aber nicht fliehen, sondern das eisige Herz ihres gefürchteten Vaters erwärmen. Was kann da schon passieren...?
description.en:
I'll make my evil dad good and survive this time!
I was killed for being the villain's daughter, but when I opened my eyes, I was 14 years back in time. Too young and penniless, I decided to wait to escape... But why should I have to run away?! What if I train my dad to be good instead?
description.es:
¡Reformaré a mi malvado padre para sobrevivir!
Me ejecutaron por ser la hija del villano. Creí que ahí terminaría mi vida, pero regresé en el tiempo a mi infancia. Sin dinero y sin fuerzas, decidí esperar a ser más grande para escapar de mi trágico destino. Aunque… ¿no sería mejor si purifico el oscuro corazón de mi padre en lugar de huir?
description.fr: Vilisa est la fille de Kasys Valois, le vilain de l’empire Rolls. Raison suffisante pour être condamnée à mort et exécutée par l’empereur. Mais lorsqu’elle rouvre les yeux, quatorze ans plus tôt, elle se retrouve face à l’événement qui a fait basculer son père dans la folie. Deux choix s’offrent à elle: s’enfuir avant de se retrouver sur l’échafaud ou rester et tenter d’apaiser le chagrin de Kasys. Mais quelles sont ses chances de transformer le vilain en papa poule?
description.it: Renderò buono il mio cattivo padre e sopravviverò questa volta! Sono stata uccisa perché ero la figlia del cattivo, ma quando ho aperto gli occhi, ero tornata indietro di 14 anni nel tempo. Troppo giovane e senza un soldo, ho deciso di aspettare per scappare... Ma perché dovrei scappare?! E se invece alleno mio padre a essere buono?
description.ko:

아빠를 조련해 착한 사람으로 만들었다.

description.de: Nach 99 Leben als ‚Profi-Extra' erhält die unschuldig hingerichtete Herzogstochter Billicia eine besondere Macht: Regression! In ihrem 100. Leben will sie aber nicht fliehen, sondern das eisige Herz ihres gefürchteten Vaters erwärmen. Was kann da schon passieren...?
description.en:
I'll make my evil dad good and survive this time!
I was killed for being the villain's daughter, but when I opened my eyes, I was 14 years back in time. Too young and penniless, I decided to wait to escape... But why should I have to run away?! What if I train my dad to be good instead?
description.es:
¡Reformaré a mi malvado padre para sobrevivir!
Me ejecutaron por ser la hija del villano. Creí que ahí terminaría mi vida, pero regresé en el tiempo a mi infancia. Sin dinero y sin fuerzas, decidí esperar a ser más grande para escapar de mi trágico destino. Aunque… ¿no sería mejor si purifico el oscuro corazón de mi padre en lugar de huir?
description.fr: Vilisa est la fille de Kasys Valois, le vilain de l’empire Rolls. Raison suffisante pour être condamnée à mort et exécutée par l’empereur. Mais lorsqu’elle rouvre les yeux, quatorze ans plus tôt, elle se retrouve face à l’événement qui a fait basculer son père dans la folie. Deux choix s’offrent à elle: s’enfuir avant de se retrouver sur l’échafaud ou rester et tenter d’apaiser le chagrin de Kasys. Mais quelles sont ses chances de transformer le vilain en papa poule?
description.it: Renderò buono il mio cattivo padre e sopravviverò questa volta! Sono stata uccisa perché ero la figlia del cattivo, ma quando ho aperto gli occhi, ero tornata indietro di 14 anni nel tempo. Troppo giovane e senza un soldo, ho deciso di aspettare per scappare... Ma perché dovrei scappare?! E se invece alleno mio padre a essere buono?
description.ko:
악역의 딸이라는 이유로 사형당했다.

‘이놈들아, 난 아무것도 안 했다고!’

억울해하며 눈을 뜨니 14년 전으로 돌아왔다.
아직 악역 가문의 보살핌이 필요한 나는 용돈을 모아 탈출하기로 계획했는데…

“죽이면 끝나는 거 아닌가. 골치 아프게 협상을 왜….”
“협상하는 아빠 조아.”
“협상하도록 하지.”

무려 인생 2회차. 금수저가 탈출을 왜 해!?
아빠를 조련해 착한 사람으로 만들었다.

히히. 세상 사람들.
이제 우리 아빠 악역 아니거든요!



아하, 샌드위치 만들다가 그런 거구나.
그럼 그럼!

우리 아빠는 이제 착해졌다구요!
description.th: ฉันจะทำให้คุณพ่อกลายเป็นคนดีและมีชีวิตรอดไปให้ได้! ฉันถูกฆ่าด้วยเหตุผลเพียงเพราะเป็นลูกสาวของคนร้าย พอฉันลืมตาตื่นขึ้นมาอีกครั้ง กลับพบว่าตัวเองย้อนกลับมาเมื่อ 14 ปีก่อน ที่ทั้งเด็กเกินไปและไม่มีเงินติดตัวเลยสักนิด ฉันเลยตัดสินใจที่จะรอสักพักก่อนจะหนี… แต่ทำไมฉันต้องหนีด้วยล่ะ? ในเมื่อฉันสามารถฝึกคุณพ่อให้เป็นคนดีได้นี่?
description.pt-br:
"Depois de 100 vidas como a filha do vilão, tudo o que quero é um final feliz."

Na minha 99ª vida, fui executada só por ser a filha do vilão. Quando voltei a abrir os olhos, percebi que tinha voltado 14 anos no tempo e que estava de volta sob os cuidados da família do vilão. Por causa disso, decidi que precisava juntar dinheiro para fugir. Mas e se eu conseguisse convencer meu pai a não ser mais um vilão e virar uma pessoa legal...?

아직 악역 가문의 보살핌이 필요한 나는 용돈을 모아 탈출하기로 계획했는데…

“죽이면 끝나는 거 아닌가. 골치 아프게 협상을 왜….”
“협상하는 아빠 조아.”
“협상하도록 하지.”

무려 인생 2회차. 금수저가 탈출을 왜 해!?
아빠를 조련해 착한 사람으로 만들었다.

히히. 세상 사람들.
이제 우리 아빠 악역 아니거든요!



아하, 샌드위치 만들다가 그런 거구나.
그럼 그럼!

우리 아빠는 이제 착해졌다구요!
description.th: ฉันจะทำให้คุณพ่อกลายเป็นคนดีและมีชีวิตรอดไปให้ได้! ฉันถูกฆ่าด้วยเหตุผลเพียงเพราะเป็นลูกสาวของคนร้าย พอฉันลืมตาตื่นขึ้นมาอีกครั้ง กลับพบว่าตัวเองย้อนกลับมาเมื่อ 14 ปีก่อน ที่ทั้งเด็กเกินไปและไม่มีเงินติดตัวเลยสักนิด ฉันเลยตัดสินใจที่จะรอสักพักก่อนจะหนี… แต่ทำไมฉันต้องหนีด้วยล่ะ? ในเมื่อฉันสามารถฝึกคุณพ่อให้เป็นคนดีได้นี่?
description.pt-br:
"Depois de 100 vidas como a filha do vilão, tudo o que quero é um final feliz."

Na minha 99ª vida, fui executada só por ser a filha do vilão. Quando voltei a abrir os olhos, percebi que tinha voltado 14 anos no tempo e que estava de volta sob os cuidados da família do vilão. Por causa disso, decidi que precisava juntar dinheiro para fugir. Mas e se eu conseguisse convencer meu pai a não ser mais um vilão e virar uma pessoa legal...?

description.de: Nach 99 Leben als ‚Profi-Extra' erhält die unschuldig hingerichtete Herzogstochter Billicia eine besondere Macht: Regression! In ihrem 100. Leben will sie aber nicht fliehen, sondern das eisige Herz ihres gefürchteten Vaters erwärmen. Was kann da schon passieren...?
description.en:
I'll make my evil dad good and survive this time!
I was killed for being the villain's daughter, but when I opened my eyes, I was 14 years back in time. Too young and penniless, I decided to wait to escape... But why should I have to run away?! What if I train my dad to be good instead?
description.es:
¡Reformaré a mi malvado padre para sobrevivir!
Me ejecutaron por ser la hija del villano. Creí que ahí terminaría mi vida, pero regresé en el tiempo a mi infancia. Sin dinero y sin fuerzas, decidí esperar a ser más grande para escapar de mi trágico destino. Aunque… ¿no sería mejor si purifico el oscuro corazón de mi padre en lugar de huir?
description.fr: Vilisa est la fille de Kasys Valois, le vilain de l’empire Rolls. Raison suffisante pour être condamnée à mort et exécutée par l’empereur. Mais lorsqu’elle rouvre les yeux, quatorze ans plus tôt, elle se retrouve face à l’événement qui a fait basculer son père dans la folie. Deux choix s’offrent à elle: s’enfuir avant de se retrouver sur l’échafaud ou rester et tenter d’apaiser le chagrin de Kasys. Mais quelles sont ses chances de transformer le vilain en papa poule?
description.it: Renderò buono il mio cattivo padre e sopravviverò questa volta! Sono stata uccisa perché ero la figlia del cattivo, ma quando ho aperto gli occhi, ero tornata indietro di 14 anni nel tempo. Troppo giovane e senza un soldo, ho deciso di aspettare per scappare... Na minha 99ª vida, fui executada só por ser a filha do vilão. Quando voltei a abrir os olhos, percebi que tinha voltado 14 anos no tempo e que estava de volta sob os cuidados da família do vilão. Por causa disso, decidi que precisava juntar dinheiro para fugir. Mas e se eu conseguisse convencer meu pai a não ser mais um vilão e virar uma pessoa legal...?

description.de: Nach 99 Leben als ‚Profi-Extra' erhält die unschuldig hingerichtete Herzogstochter Billicia eine besondere Macht: Regression! In ihrem 100. Leben will sie aber nicht fliehen, sondern das eisige Herz ihres gefürchteten Vaters erwärmen. Was kann da schon passieren...?
description.en:
I'll make my evil dad good and survive this time!
I was killed for being the villain's daughter, but when I opened my eyes, I was 14 years back in time. Too young and penniless, I decided to wait to escape... But why should I have to run away?! What if I train my dad to be good instead?
description.es:
¡Reformaré a mi malvado padre para sobrevivir!
Me ejecutaron por ser la hija del villano. Creí que ahí terminaría mi vida, pero regresé en el tiempo a mi infancia. Sin dinero y sin fuerzas, decidí esperar a ser más grande para escapar de mi trágico destino. Aunque… ¿no sería mejor si purifico el oscuro corazón de mi padre en lugar de huir?
description.fr: Vilisa est la fille de Kasys Valois, le vilain de l’empire Rolls. Raison suffisante pour être condamnée à mort et exécutée par l’empereur. Mais lorsqu’elle rouvre les yeux, quatorze ans plus tôt, elle se retrouve face à l’événement qui a fait basculer son père dans la folie. Deux choix s’offrent à elle: s’enfuir avant de se retrouver sur l’échafaud ou rester et tenter d’apaiser le chagrin de Kasys. Mais quelles sont ses chances de transformer le vilain en papa poule?
description.it: Renderò buono il mio cattivo padre e sopravviverò questa volta! Sono stata uccisa perché ero la figlia del cattivo, ma quando ho aperto gli occhi, ero tornata indietro di 14 anni nel tempo. Troppo giovane e senza un soldo, ho deciso di aspettare per scappare... Ma perché dovrei scappare?! E se invece alleno mio padre a essere buono?
description.ko:
악역의 딸이라는 이유로 사형당했다.

‘이놈들아, 난 아무것도 안 했다고!’

억울해하며 눈을 뜨니 14년 전으로 돌아왔다.
아직 악역 가문의 보살핌이 필요한 나는 용돈을 모아 탈출하기로 계획했는데…

“죽이면 끝나는 거 아닌가. 골치 아프게 협상을 왜….”
“협상하는 아빠 조아.”
“협상하도록 하지.”

무려 인생 2회차. 금수저가 탈출을 왜 해!?
아빠를 조련해 착한 사람으로 만들었다.

히히. 세상 사람들.
이제 우리 아빠 악역 아니거든요!



아하, 샌드위치 만들다가 그런 거구나.
그럼 그럼!

우리 아빠는 이제 착해졌다구요!
description.th: ฉันจะทำให้คุณพ่อกลายเป็นคนดีและมีชีวิตรอดไปให้ได้! ฉันถูกฆ่าด้วยเหตุผลเพียงเพราะเป็นลูกสาวของคนร้าย พอฉันลืมตาตื่นขึ้นมาอีกครั้ง กลับพบว่าตัวเองย้อนกลับมาเมื่อ 14 ปีก่อน ที่ทั้งเด็กเกินไปและไม่มีเงินติดตัวเลยสักนิด ฉันเลยตัดสินใจที่จะรอสักพักก่อนจะหนี… แต่ทำไมฉันต้องหนีด้วยล่ะ? ในเมื่อฉันสามารถฝึกคุณพ่อให้เป็นคนดีได้นี่?

altTitles.en: Angelic Lady

description.en:
Angela was my friend. I wanted to give anything to her, who I thought more precious than my own family. And I eventually turned Angela, a lowly aristocrat from the countryside, into the flower of the capital society. But it was betrayal that came back. She sold me and my family to become an imperial princess.

"…Did you have to go this far?"
"Because I wanted you to be unhappy. I wanted to take your whole life away."

But when I thought I had died under the guillotine, I was surprisingly back in the past.

"Oh, hello. My name is Angela Vito…"
"You're Angela! Nice to meet you. Everyone was waiting for you."

With a bright smile, I held her hands together again.

---
My best friend betrayed me! Born from a low-ranking noble family, Angela grew to be renowned for her beauty and grace, becoming the prized angel of society, all with my enthusiastic support. Yet beneath that glitz and polish, she was simply... evil. She used me and had me killed out of sheer spite in her quest to become the empire’s greatest woman. But unlucky for her, a magical gift from a dragon has given me a second chance at life. No longer blinded by her light, I’ll do all I can to stop her!
description.fr:
Angela était mon amie. J'aurai pu faire n'importe quoi pour celle que je considérais comme plus précieuse que ma propre famille. Et j'ai fini par transformer Angela, une humble aristocrate de la campagne, en la fleur de la société. En remerciement je n'ai reçu que mensonge et trahison. Elle nous a vendu, ma famille et moi, pour devenir une princesse impériale.

"…Fallait-il que tu ailles aussi loin?"
"Je voulais que tu sois malheureuse. Je voulais te prendre toute ta vie."

Et lorsque j'ai cru mourir guillotiné, je suis revenue dans le passé.

"Oh, bonjour. Je m'appelle Angela Vito…"
"Vous êtes Angela ! Ravie de vous rencontrer. Tout le monde vous attendait."

Avec un sourire éclatant, je lui ai de nouveau tenu les mains.

---
Angela est ma chère amie à qui j’ai donné tout mon cœur, et elle m'a remerciée... en me trahisant. Pour devenir princesse héritière, elle a détruit ma famille et m’a envoyée à la guillotine. Mais au moment de l'exécution, je suis remontée dans le temps comme par miracle pour me retrouver au jour de ma première rencontre avec elle. Cette fois-ci, je ne me laisserai pas faire: ce sera maintenant à mon tour la faire souffrir.

altTitles.en: The Gardener in a Hunter World
Gardener in Hunter's World

description.en:
Ji-ha, the weakest labor-class hunter with neither skill nor fighting ability, made a living by running a store while holding the lowest hunter rank.

But one day, his life as a hunter changed when he entered a garden from a different dimension through his dream...

<You have obtained Friendly Plant Lv.1> <You have obtained Blessing of XXX Lv.1>

'I gained a skill just by planting one twig...?'

His unique adventure as the sole gardener in the hunter world begins.

title.en: The Little Lady Behind the Scenes

altTitles.en: An Unseemly Lady

altTitles.fr: La petite Lady tire les ficelles
Rosie, la fille du duc diabolique

altTitles.uk: Впливова леді

altTitles.th: เลดี้จอมบงการ

altTitles.ja: レディは陰の実力者

description.en:
Julianne is as close to perfect as it gets: she’s got looks, talent, and smarts. The only problem is she has terrible taste in men! That’s why her little sister Lilianne is doing everything she can to make sure she doesn’t end up with the wrong guy. However, Julianne’s suitors are quickly catching on that the way to her heart is through Lilianne’s sweet tooth! How far will Lilianne go to set her sister up with the right man? Who will be the sweetest suitor?

---
I was the only younger sister of the female protagonist in the reverse harem novel. In addition, I was exceptionally pampered by the female lead after waking up after being very sick. I used that to defeat the original inexcusable trash male leads who only hurt my sister…

‘Lili, how are you? Do you like cake?’

‘Lili is really pretty because she resembles her sister. Won’t you eat cookies? Please tell your sister that these were given to you by your wonderful brother.’

‘Would you like to eat this and go over there for a while? I have something to say to your uncle and sister.’

For some reason, the male lead candidates seem anxious to see me.

**

“I don’t play with ugly kids," the boy in front of me muttered with a deep frown.

What? Did you really just say that? I’ll show you what the real world is like.

I gently pulled the hem of my sister’s clothes and shook my head, “I hate him, so I hate the older brother who brought him.”

At the same time, Cedric’s face turned pale, similar to someone who had been sentenced to death.

description.en:
Upon dying, the author of "The Demon King is Dead" is given two choices: go to hell or be reborn in his novel and survive till the end.

The problem? He's reborn as Baalier Junior, a weak demon prince, after his realm was conquered! To make things worse, his attempt to escape somehow gets him enrolled as a student of the Royal Class in Gradias Temple, a prestigious human school.

In the midst of plotlines and political schemes, can this author keep his identity a secret and reach a happy ending?
description.ja: 自分が書いた小説のアンチコメントを読んで頭に血がのぼり死んでしまった。 そんなあっけない死に方をした俺の前になぜか死神(？)が現れ、「常習的な休載」「失敗を何度も繰り返した」という罪により、完結作の中から選んだ『魔王は死んだ』という自作の小説に転生することになったが… よりによって物語の序盤で死んでしまう魔王の息子に転生してしまった…!? ＜小説のエンディングまで生き残るために最善を尽くしてください＞

The problem? He's reborn as Baalier Junior, a weak demon prince, after his realm was conquered! To make things worse, his attempt to escape somehow gets him enrolled as a student of the Royal Class in Gradias Temple, a prestigious human school.

In the midst of plotlines and political schemes, can this author keep his identity a secret and reach a happy ending?
description.ja: 自分が書いた小説のアンチコメントを読んで頭に血がのぼり死んでしまった。 そんなあっけない死に方をした俺の前になぜか死神(？)が現れ、「常習的な休載」「失敗を何度も繰り返した」という罪により、完結作の中から選んだ『魔王は死んだ』という自作の小説に転生することになったが… よりによって物語の序盤で死んでしまう魔王の息子に転生してしまった…!? ＜小説のエンディングまで生き残るために最善を尽くしてください＞

description.en:
In a brutal medieval world where innocence means life and guilt means death, Aron, captain of the castle guard, enforces order within the fortress. But when demons begin to corrupt men’s hearts, violent events erupt, including repeated attempts to assassinate the lady of the castle. As Aron hunts the culprits, he encounters a demon that marks him, granting incredible strength but tainting his body with dark magic. Now, with his mind clouded and powers growing, Aron must unravel the mystery before the castle and his soul fall to ruin.

---
In a brutal, lawless medieval world where war and poverty reign, and twisted magic defies all reason, the captain of the guards grinds through another grueling day, pushing his battered body to the limit in a land where survival itself is a merciless test.
description.fr: Aaron se retrouve propulsé dans un monde médiéval fantastique peuplé d’ignares, où le droit du travail n'existe pas. L’infâme ordure des gardes du château Casserdic va devoir tout faire pour survivre dans ce monde de guerre, de magie, de pauvreté... et de démons. Sans oublier, bien sûr, d’éduquer ces abrutis médiévaux.
description.id:
Terlempar ke dalam cerita fantasi berlatar abad pertengahan?! Dengan kondisi dunia yang sangat kejam dan dikuasai perang, sihir, serta berbagai hal aneh lainnya, Aaron harus menjabat sebagai ketua tim penjaga. Mampukah Aaron bertahan hidup di masa ketika hukum dan pandangan moral masih sangat primitif?

---
Di dunia abad pertengahan yang brutal dan tanpa hukum dimana peperangan dan kemiskinan merajalela, Serta magic gila yang membantah segala akal sehat, Kapten penjaga melalui hari baru yang melelahkan lagi, Memaksa tubuh lelahnya di tanah dimana bertahan hidup pun sudah seperti ujian yang keji.
description.ko:
노동법도 없는 무식한 중세.
전쟁과 빈곤, 마법과 비상식이 지배하는 이곳에서
경비조장은 오늘도 뺑이를 친다.
description.zh-hk: 轉生到這個沒有勞基法可言的中世紀異世界，轉眼間竟然已經過了六年……即使身懷不凡戰力，亞倫依然屈居警衛組長一職。就算他不願踏入任何紛爭，在這個貧富交錯、魔法縱橫的世界裡，衝突依然會不請自來。就在看似平凡的某一天，詭異的護送行動強行開啟了冒險的序幕！

description.en:
The past has changed, but like a fiery comet, he still comes. 

Mugi Hwa, the one without equal, slashed through Murim's skies with his sword, toppling every lord who dared to face him – even Cheonma, Mugeuk Geom’s father. But Mugeuk didn’t accept defeat. Instead, he turned to the forbidden: a time-bending ritual that hurled him into his own past. 

Now, retracing his steps, he races against the clock until Mugi emerges once again. But this time, it's not just about power, but mending old wounds and forging new bonds to unite his people and prepare for the bloodtide to come.
description.ko:
"나를 과거로 보내주시오."

이 시대에서 그를 죽일 수 없다면, 과거로 돌아가면 되리라. 시간을 거스를 수 있는 '회귀대법(回歸大法)'으로 그토록 원하던 과거로 회귀한 한 남자. 

가족도, 친구도, 삶도, 모두 잃었던 '검무극(劍無極)'의 복수를 위한 첫걸음이 시작된다.

이 시대에서 그를 죽일 수 없다면, 과거로 돌아가면 되리라. 시간을 거스를 수 있는 '회귀대법(回歸大法)'으로 그토록 원하던 과거로 회귀한 한 남자. 

가족도, 친구도, 삶도, 모두 잃었던 '검무극(劍無極)'의 복수를 위한 첫걸음이 시작된다.

altTitles.fr: La régression parfaite
La régression absolue

altTitles.en: Absolute Regression

description.en:
The past has changed, but like a fiery comet, he still comes. 

Mugi Hwa, the one without equal, slashed through Murim's skies with his sword, toppling every lord who dared to face him – even Cheonma, Mugeuk Geom’s father. But Mugeuk didn’t accept defeat. Instead, he turned to the forbidden: a time-bending ritual that hurled him into his own past. 

Now, retracing his steps, he races against the clock until Mugi emerges once again. But this time, it's not just about power, but mending old wounds and forging new bonds to unite his people and prepare for the bloodtide to come.

description.en:
I "transmigrated" into a world I'd never seen before.

For 30 years, I believed I was living in a classic fantasy RPG.
I became a war hero, retired, and thought I was finally about to see the ending.
But...

Those 30 years were only the prologue.
It turns out the real story is about an academy?
description.ko:
처음 보는 세계에 ‘빙의’했다. 
왕도 RPG라고 생각하고 30년을 보냈다. 
전쟁영웅이 되어 퇴역했고, 이제 엔딩을 맞이할 예정이었다. 

그런데ㅡ 
지금까지의 30년이 프롤로그였고, 심지어 아카데미물이었다고?
description.ru: Я оказался внутри незнакомой игры. Решив, что это классическая RPG, я прожил в ней тридцать лет, стал героем войны, вышел в отставку и собирался спокойно провести оставшееся время. Но что? Всё это время это была история про академию?

description.en:
Heavenly Demons, Hunters, Giant Robots, Demon Kings, and Superhumans.

The strongest warriors from countless worlds gather in one place, with the survival of their respective worlds at stake.

In this battle for survival, where defeat means nothing less than the destruction of an entire world, the representatives of the “Ordinary World”—the only ones with no special powers whatsoever—are dragged into the conflict.

Just as they are about to be crushed by the overwhelming strength of monsters who exist far beyond normal standards, they are given an unexpected weapon.

[The abilities of your game character are being synchronized]

Can Shin Jahyeon and the representatives of the Ordinary World borrow the powers of their game characters, defeat the true strongest beings, and survive?

description.en: Jaehyun may be the composed upperclassman on campus, but he secretly plays the hottest elven diva online with a love of pricey costumes. He meets Eunsung, a handsome first-year with deep pockets guarding his own secrets, at a school event. They connect instantly, but what begins as a sweet challenge becomes a risky game of affection on- and offline!

description.de:
Liese Estelle ist eine geniale Ärztin. Sie wird ungerechterweise zum Tode verurteilt, weil sie einen Rebellen behandelt hat, aber im Gefängnis hilft sie einer alten Frau, die sie ihr Leben noch einmal leben lässt! Beim letzten Mal führte der Tod des jungen Erben Erwan zu einer Rebellion. Dann muss ihr Ziel in diesem Leben die Gesundheit von Erwan sein!
„Niemand ist mehr auf Lord Erwans Seite als ich!“ - „Lauft! Na lauft! Ihr müsst Euer Immunsystem aufbauen!“ - „Esst dieses Kraut! Es ist gut für Euch.“
Dank ihr wird Erwan ein gesunder und kräftiger Erwachsener. Liese kann erleichtert ihre Position kündigen…
„Du sagtest, du stehst für immer auf meiner Seite.“ – „Wie könnte ich dich gehen lassen?“
Ähm... So war das nicht geplant?! Wird Liese kündigen können?
description.en:
Rita Estelle knows that Duke Erwan Cereus will fall ill and die, leading to a bloody rebellion. She knows this because she would've died in that rebellion had it not been for a kindly sorceress who sent her back in time. With her second chance at life, Rita seeks to use her medical genius to get close to Duke Erwan as a child and cure him. But the closer she grows to him, the more she suspects his sickness is caused by foul play. Can Rita save Erwan and the whole country before it's too late?
___
When the duke, who was in poor condition, suddenly died, the land fell into the hands of the rebels. In a short time, the rebellion was suppressed by the royal family, but… The point is that I, Lise Estelle, will be hanged for treason. “It’s not fair!” I’m simply the best doctor in the area. If that’s the case, I’ll become the duke’s doctor this time so there’s no rebellion, and I’ll make the duke’s heir healthy! “No one cares about you as much as I do. Therefore, you must definitely listen to me!"
description.fr: Condamnée à mort lors de la Fronde, Rita, médecin de génie, se croit perdue. Mais alors qu'elle donne son ultime consultation, on lui offre une seconde chance. Rita revient dans le passé, le jour de ses 13 ans, et décide d'entrer au service de la famille ducale afin de sauver le petit Lord et d'éviter la Fronde. La jeune médecin n'a plus qu'un objectif: découvrir la source des maladies inconnues qui affaiblissent cette famille. Mais les sauver ne sera peut-être pas seulement de l'ordre du médical!
description.id: Setelah Duke Erwan meninggal, terjadi pemberontakan di wilayah kekuasaannya. Rita, seorang dokter berbakat dijatuhi hukuman mati karena mengobati pemberontak. Namun saat dipenjara, ia bertemu dengan seorang nenek yang mengirimnya kembali ke masa lalu. Akhirnya, Rita berencana mencegah pemberontakan dengan menyelamatkan Duke Erwan. Akankah misi Rita berhasil, dan apa yang terjadi dengan Duke Erwan?
description.ko:
영지 최고의 실력을 자랑하는 의사, 리체 에스텔.

반란군을 치료했다는 이유로 억울하게 투옥되지만,
그곳에서 한 할머니를 치료해준 보답으로
다시 한 번 생을 살 수 있게 되었다!

과거 반란의 원인은 소공자 에르안의 급사.
그렇다면 이번 생의 목표는 '소공자를 건강하게!'

"저만큼 에르안 님을 위하는 사람은 없어요!"
"뛰세요! 뛰시라고요! 면역력을 길러야 하니까!"
"이 풀 드세요. 몸에 좋은 거예요."

덕분에 에르안은 건강을 넘어 건장한 성인이 되고
리체는 마음 편히 사표를 내지만…

"너는 유일하게 나를 위하는 사람이라고 했잖아."
"내가 어떻게 너를 놓을 수 있겠어?"

어랏? 이게 아닌데?!
리체는 과연 퇴사를 할 수 있을까?!
description.pt-br: Lize Stelle, uma médica que possui as melhores habilidades da região. Ela é presa injustamente por tratar os rebeldes, mas em troca de tratar uma velha senhora, ela conseguiu uma nova chance de mudar o presente! A causa da rebelião no passado foi a morte repentina de Ethan, o pequeno príncipe do ducado. Então, o objetivo desta vida é ‘deixar o pequeno duque saudável!’ “Ninguém se importa com Ethan tanto quanto eu!” “Corra! Corra! Você precisa aumentar sua imunidade!” “Coma esta erva. É bom para o seu corpo.” Graças a isso, Ethan consegue ir além da saúde e se tornar um adulto forte. E Lize se demite com facilidade, mas… “Você disse que era a única que estava lá para mim. Como posso deixá-la ir?” Hã? O que é isso?! Lize poderá renunciar?!

description.de:
Liese Estelle ist eine geniale Ärztin. Sie wird ungerechterweise zum Tode verurteilt, weil sie einen Rebellen behandelt hat, aber im Gefängnis hilft sie einer alten Frau, die sie ihr Leben noch einmal leben lässt! Beim letzten Mal führte der Tod des jungen Erben Erwan zu einer Rebellion. Dann muss ihr Ziel in diesem Leben die Gesundheit von Erwan sein!
„Niemand ist mehr auf Lord Erwans Seite als ich!“ - „Lauft! Na lauft! Ihr müsst Euer Immunsystem aufbauen!“ - „Esst dieses Kraut! Es ist gut für Euch.“
Dank ihr wird Erwan ein gesunder und kräftiger Erwachsener. Liese kann erleichtert ihre Position kündigen…
„Du sagtest, du stehst für immer auf meiner Seite.“ – „Wie könnte ich dich gehen lassen?“
Ähm... So war das nicht geplant?! Wird Liese kündigen können?
description.en:
Rita Estelle knows that Duke Erwan Cereus will fall ill and die, leading to a bloody rebellion. She knows this because she would've died in that rebellion had it not been for a kindly sorceress who sent her back in time. With her second chance at life, Rita seeks to use her medical genius to get close to Duke Erwan as a child and cure him. But the closer she grows to him, the more she suspects his sickness is caused by foul play. Can Rita save Erwan and the whole country before it's too late?
___
When the duke, who was in poor condition, suddenly died, the land fell into the hands of the rebels. In a short time, the rebellion was suppressed by the royal family, but… The point is that I, Lise Estelle, will be hanged for treason. “It’s not fair!” I’m simply the best doctor in the area. If that’s the case, I’ll become the duke’s doctor this time so there’s no rebellion, and I’ll make the duke’s heir healthy! “No one cares about you as much as I do. Therefore, you must definitely listen to me!"
description.fr: Condamnée à mort lors de la Fronde, Rita, médecin de génie, se croit perdue. Mais alors qu'elle donne son ultime consultation, on lui offre une seconde chance. Rita revient dans le passé, le jour de ses 13 ans, et décide d'entrer au service de la famille ducale afin de sauver le petit Lord et d'éviter la Fronde. La jeune médecin n'a plus qu'un objectif: découvrir la source des maladies inconnues qui affaiblissent cette famille. Mais les sauver ne sera peut-être pas seulement de l'ordre du médical!
description.id: Setelah Duke Erwan meninggal, terjadi pemberontakan di wilayah kekuasaannya. Rita, seorang dokter berbakat dijatuhi hukuman mati karena mengobati pemberontak. Namun saat dipenjara, ia bertemu dengan seorang nenek yang mengirimnya kembali ke masa lalu. Akhirnya, Rita berencana mencegah pemberontakan dengan menyelamatkan Duke Erwan. Akankah misi Rita berhasil, dan apa yang terjadi dengan Duke Erwan?
description.ko:
영지 최고의 실력을 자랑하는 의사, 리체 에스텔.

반란군을 치료했다는 이유로 억울하게 투옥되지만,
그곳에서 한 할머니를 치료해준 보답으로
다시 한 번 생을 살 수 있게 되었다!

과거 반란의 원인은 소공자 에르안의 급사.
그렇다면 이번 생의 목표는 '소공자를 건강하게!'

"저만큼 에르안 님을 위하는 사람은 없어요!"
"뛰세요! 뛰시라고요! 면역력을 길러야 하니까!"
"이 풀 드세요. 몸에 좋은 거예요."

덕분에 에르안은 건강을 넘어 건장한 성인이 되고
리체는 마음 편히 사표를 내지만…

"너는 유일하게 나를 위하는 사람이라고 했잖아."
"내가 어떻게 너를 놓을 수 있겠어?"

어랏? 이게 아닌데?!
리체는 과연 퇴사를 할 수 있을까?!
description.pt-br: Lize Stelle, uma médica que possui as melhores habilidades da região. Ela é presa injustamente por tratar os rebeldes, mas em troca de tratar uma velha senhora, ela conseguiu uma nova chance de mudar o presente! A causa da rebelião no passado foi a morte repentina de Ethan, o pequeno príncipe do ducado. Então, o objetivo desta vida é ‘deixar o pequeno duque saudável!’ “Ninguém se importa com Ethan tanto quanto eu!” “Corra! Corra! Você precisa aumentar sua imunidade!” “Coma esta erva. É bom para o seu corpo.” Graças a isso, Ethan consegue ir além da saúde e se tornar um adulto forte. E Lize se demite com facilidade, mas… “Você disse que era a única que estava lá para mim. Como posso deixá-la ir?” Hã? O que é isso?! Lize poderá renunciar?!

A causa da rebelião no passado foi a morte repentina de Ethan, o pequeno príncipe do ducado. Então, o objetivo desta vida é ‘deixar o pequeno duque saudável!’ “Ninguém se importa com Ethan tanto quanto eu!” “Corra! Corra! Você precisa aumentar sua imunidade!” “Coma esta erva. É bom para o seu corpo.” Graças a isso, Ethan consegue ir além da saúde e se tornar um adulto forte. E Lize se demite com facilidade, mas… “Você disse que era a única que estava lá para mim. Como posso deixá-la ir?” Hã? O que é isso?! Lize poderá renunciar?!

description.de:
Liese Estelle ist eine geniale Ärztin. Sie wird ungerechterweise zum Tode verurteilt, weil sie einen Rebellen behandelt hat, aber im Gefängnis hilft sie einer alten Frau, die sie ihr Leben noch einmal leben lässt! Beim letzten Mal führte der Tod des jungen Erben Erwan zu einer Rebellion. Dann muss ihr Ziel in diesem Leben die Gesundheit von Erwan sein!
„Niemand ist mehr auf Lord Erwans Seite als ich!“ - „Lauft! Na lauft! Ihr müsst Euer Immunsystem aufbauen!“ - „Esst dieses Kraut! Es ist gut für Euch.“
Dank ihr wird Erwan ein gesunder und kräftiger Erwachsener. Liese kann erleichtert ihre Position kündigen…
„Du sagtest, du stehst für immer auf meiner Seite.“ – „Wie könnte ich dich gehen lassen?“
Ähm... So war das nicht geplant?! Wird Liese kündigen können?
description.en:
Rita Estelle knows that Duke Erwan Cereus will fall ill and die, leading to a bloody rebellion. She knows this because she would've died in that rebellion had it not been for a kindly sorceress who sent her back in time. With her second chance at life, Rita seeks to use her medical genius to get close to Duke Erwan as a child and cure him. But the closer she grows to him, the more she suspects his sickness is caused by foul play. Can Rita save Erwan and the whole country before it's too late?
___
When the duke, who was in poor condition, suddenly died, the land fell into the hands of the rebels. In a short time, the rebellion was suppressed by the royal family, but… The point is that I, Lise Estelle, will be hanged for treason. “It’s not fair!” I’m simply the best doctor in the area. If that’s the case, I’ll become the duke’s doctor this time so there’s no rebellion, and I’ll make the duke’s heir healthy! “No one cares about you as much as I do. Therefore, you must definitely listen to me!"
description.fr: Condamnée à mort lors de la Fronde, Rita, médecin de génie, se croit perdue. Mais alors qu'elle donne son ultime consultation, on lui offre une seconde chance. Rita revient dans le passé, le jour de ses 13 ans, et décide d'entrer au service de la famille ducale afin de sauver le petit Lord et d'éviter la Fronde. La jeune médecin n'a plus qu'un objectif: découvrir la source des maladies inconnues qui affaiblissent cette famille. Mais les sauver ne sera peut-être pas seulement de l'ordre du médical!
description.id: Setelah Duke Erwan meninggal, terjadi pemberontakan di wilayah kekuasaannya. Rita, seorang dokter berbakat dijatuhi hukuman mati karena mengobati pemberontak. Namun saat dipenjara, ia bertemu dengan seorang nenek yang mengirimnya kembali ke masa lalu. Akhirnya, Rita berencana mencegah pemberontakan dengan menyelamatkan Duke Erwan. Akankah misi Rita berhasil, dan apa yang terjadi dengan Duke Erwan?
description.ko:
영지 최고의 실력을 자랑하는 의사, 리체 에스텔.

반란군을 치료했다는 이유로 억울하게 투옥되지만,
그곳에서 한 할머니를 치료해준 보답으로
다시 한 번 생을 살 수 있게 되었다!

과거 반란의 원인은 소공자 에르안의 급사.
그렇다면 이번 생의 목표는 '소공자를 건강하게!'

"저만큼 에르안 님을 위하는 사람은 없어요!"
"뛰세요! 뛰시라고요! 면역력을 길러야 하니까!"
"이 풀 드세요. 몸에 좋은 거예요."

덕분에 에르안은 건강을 넘어 건장한 성인이 되고
리체는 마음 편히 사표를 내지만…

"너는 유일하게 나를 위하는 사람이라고 했잖아."
"내가 어떻게 너를 놓을 수 있겠어?"

어랏? 이게 아닌데?!
리체는 과연 퇴사를 할 수 있을까?!

Então, o objetivo desta vida é ‘deixar o pequeno duque saudável!’ “Ninguém se importa com Ethan tanto quanto eu!” “Corra! Corra! Você precisa aumentar sua imunidade!” “Coma esta erva. É bom para o seu corpo.” Graças a isso, Ethan consegue ir além da saúde e se tornar um adulto forte. E Lize se demite com facilidade, mas… “Você disse que era a única que estava lá para mim. Como posso deixá-la ir?” Hã? O que é isso?! Lize poderá renunciar?!

description.de:
Liese Estelle ist eine geniale Ärztin. Sie wird ungerechterweise zum Tode verurteilt, weil sie einen Rebellen behandelt hat, aber im Gefängnis hilft sie einer alten Frau, die sie ihr Leben noch einmal leben lässt! Beim letzten Mal führte der Tod des jungen Erben Erwan zu einer Rebellion. Dann muss ihr Ziel in diesem Leben die Gesundheit von Erwan sein!
„Niemand ist mehr auf Lord Erwans Seite als ich!“ - „Lauft! Na lauft! Ihr müsst Euer Immunsystem aufbauen!“ - „Esst dieses Kraut! Es ist gut für Euch.“
Dank ihr wird Erwan ein gesunder und kräftiger Erwachsener. Liese kann erleichtert ihre Position kündigen…
„Du sagtest, du stehst für immer auf meiner Seite.“ – „Wie könnte ich dich gehen lassen?“
Ähm... So war das nicht geplant?! Wird Liese kündigen können?
description.en:
Rita Estelle knows that Duke Erwan Cereus will fall ill and die, leading to a bloody rebellion. She knows this because she would've died in that rebellion had it not been for a kindly sorceress who sent her back in time. With her second chance at life, Rita seeks to use her medical genius to get close to Duke Erwan as a child and cure him. But the closer she grows to him, the more she suspects his sickness is caused by foul play. Can Rita save Erwan and the whole country before it's too late?
___
When the duke, who was in poor condition, suddenly died, the land fell into the hands of the rebels. In a short time, the rebellion was suppressed by the royal family, but… The point is that I, Lise Estelle, will be hanged for treason. “It’s not fair!” I’m simply the best doctor in the area. If that’s the case, I’ll become the duke’s doctor this time so there’s no rebellion, and I’ll make the duke’s heir healthy! “No one cares about you as much as I do. Therefore, you must definitely listen to me!"
description.fr: Condamnée à mort lors de la Fronde, Rita, médecin de génie, se croit perdue. Mais alors qu'elle donne son ultime consultation, on lui offre une seconde chance. Rita revient dans le passé, le jour de ses 13 ans, et décide d'entrer au service de la famille ducale afin de sauver le petit Lord et d'éviter la Fronde. La jeune médecin n'a plus qu'un objectif: découvrir la source des maladies inconnues qui affaiblissent cette famille. Mais les sauver ne sera peut-être pas seulement de l'ordre du médical!
description.id: Setelah Duke Erwan meninggal, terjadi pemberontakan di wilayah kekuasaannya. Rita, seorang dokter berbakat dijatuhi hukuman mati karena mengobati pemberontak. Namun saat dipenjara, ia bertemu dengan seorang nenek yang mengirimnya kembali ke masa lalu. Akhirnya, Rita berencana mencegah pemberontakan dengan menyelamatkan Duke Erwan. Akankah misi Rita berhasil, dan apa yang terjadi dengan Duke Erwan?

그곳에서 한 할머니를 치료해준 보답으로
다시 한 번 생을 살 수 있게 되었다!

과거 반란의 원인은 소공자 에르안의 급사.
그렇다면 이번 생의 목표는 '소공자를 건강하게!'

"저만큼 에르안 님을 위하는 사람은 없어요!"
"뛰세요! 뛰시라고요! 면역력을 길러야 하니까!"
"이 풀 드세요. 몸에 좋은 거예요."

덕분에 에르안은 건강을 넘어 건장한 성인이 되고
리체는 마음 편히 사표를 내지만…

"너는 유일하게 나를 위하는 사람이라고 했잖아."
"내가 어떻게 너를 놓을 수 있겠어?"

어랏? 이게 아닌데?!
리체는 과연 퇴사를 할 수 있을까?!
description.pt-br: Lize Stelle, uma médica que possui as melhores habilidades da região. Ela é presa injustamente por tratar os rebeldes, mas em troca de tratar uma velha senhora, ela conseguiu uma nova chance de mudar o presente! A causa da rebelião no passado foi a morte repentina de Ethan, o pequeno príncipe do ducado. Então, o objetivo desta vida é ‘deixar o pequeno duque saudável!’ “Ninguém se importa com Ethan tanto quanto eu!” “Corra! Corra! Você precisa aumentar sua imunidade!” “Coma esta erva. É bom para o seu corpo.” Graças a isso, Ethan consegue ir além da saúde e se tornar um adulto forte. E Lize se demite com facilidade, mas… “Você disse que era a única que estava lá para mim. Como posso deixá-la ir?” Hã? O que é isso?! Lize poderá renunciar?!

description.de:
Liese Estelle ist eine geniale Ärztin. Sie wird ungerechterweise zum Tode verurteilt, weil sie einen Rebellen behandelt hat, aber im Gefängnis hilft sie einer alten Frau, die sie ihr Leben noch einmal leben lässt! Beim letzten Mal führte der Tod des jungen Erben Erwan zu einer Rebellion. Dann muss ihr Ziel in diesem Leben die Gesundheit von Erwan sein!
„Niemand ist mehr auf Lord Erwans Seite als ich!“ - „Lauft! Na lauft! Ihr müsst Euer Immunsystem aufbauen!“ - „Esst dieses Kraut! Es ist gut für Euch.“
Dank ihr wird Erwan ein gesunder und kräftiger Erwachsener. Liese kann erleichtert ihre Position kündigen…
„Du sagtest, du stehst für immer auf meiner Seite.“ – „Wie könnte ich dich gehen lassen?“
Ähm... So war das nicht geplant?! Wird Liese kündigen können?
description.en:
Rita Estelle knows that Duke Erwan Cereus will fall ill and die, leading to a bloody rebellion. She knows this because she would've died in that rebellion had it not been for a kindly sorceress who sent her back in time. With her second chance at life, Rita seeks to use her medical genius to get close to Duke Erwan as a child and cure him. But the closer she grows to him, the more she suspects his sickness is caused by foul play. Can Rita save Erwan and the whole country before it's too late?
___
When the duke, who was in poor condition, suddenly died, the land fell into the hands of the rebels. In a short time, the rebellion was suppressed by the royal family, but… The point is that I, Lise Estelle, will be hanged for treason. “It’s not fair!” I’m simply the best doctor in the area. If that’s the case, I’ll become the duke’s doctor this time so there’s no rebellion, and I’ll make the duke’s heir healthy! “No one cares about you as much as I do. Therefore, you must definitely listen to me!"
description.fr: Condamnée à mort lors de la Fronde, Rita, médecin de génie, se croit perdue. Mais alors qu'elle donne son ultime consultation, on lui offre une seconde chance. Rita revient dans le passé, le jour de ses 13 ans, et décide d'entrer au service de la famille ducale afin de sauver le petit Lord et d'éviter la Fronde. La jeune médecin n'a plus qu'un objectif: découvrir la source des maladies inconnues qui affaiblissent cette famille. Mais les sauver ne sera peut-être pas seulement de l'ordre du médical!
description.id: Setelah Duke Erwan meninggal, terjadi pemberontakan di wilayah kekuasaannya. Rita, seorang dokter berbakat dijatuhi hukuman mati karena mengobati pemberontak. Namun saat dipenjara, ia bertemu dengan seorang nenek yang mengirimnya kembali ke masa lalu. Akhirnya, Rita berencana mencegah pemberontakan dengan menyelamatkan Duke Erwan. Akankah misi Rita berhasil, dan apa yang terjadi dengan Duke Erwan?

description.id: Setelah Duke Erwan meninggal, terjadi pemberontakan di wilayah kekuasaannya. Rita, seorang dokter berbakat dijatuhi hukuman mati karena mengobati pemberontak. Namun saat dipenjara, ia bertemu dengan seorang nenek yang mengirimnya kembali ke masa lalu. Akhirnya, Rita berencana mencegah pemberontakan dengan menyelamatkan Duke Erwan. Akankah misi Rita berhasil, dan apa yang terjadi dengan Duke Erwan?
description.ko:
영지 최고의 실력을 자랑하는 의사, 리체 에스텔.

반란군을 치료했다는 이유로 억울하게 투옥되지만,
그곳에서 한 할머니를 치료해준 보답으로
다시 한 번 생을 살 수 있게 되었다!

과거 반란의 원인은 소공자 에르안의 급사.
그렇다면 이번 생의 목표는 '소공자를 건강하게!'

"저만큼 에르안 님을 위하는 사람은 없어요!"
"뛰세요! 뛰시라고요! 면역력을 길러야 하니까!"
"이 풀 드세요. 몸에 좋은 거예요."

덕분에 에르안은 건강을 넘어 건장한 성인이 되고
리체는 마음 편히 사표를 내지만…

"너는 유일하게 나를 위하는 사람이라고 했잖아."
"내가 어떻게 너를 놓을 수 있겠어?"

어랏? 이게 아닌데?!
리체는 과연 퇴사를 할 수 있을까?!
description.pt-br: Lize Stelle, uma médica que possui as melhores habilidades da região. Ela é presa injustamente por tratar os rebeldes, mas em troca de tratar uma velha senhora, ela conseguiu uma nova chance de mudar o presente! A causa da rebelião no passado foi a morte repentina de Ethan, o pequeno príncipe do ducado. Então, o objetivo desta vida é ‘deixar o pequeno duque saudável!’ “Ninguém se importa com Ethan tanto quanto eu!” “Corra! Corra! Você precisa aumentar sua imunidade!” “Coma esta erva. É bom para o seu corpo.” Graças a isso, Ethan consegue ir além da saúde e se tornar um adulto forte. E Lize se demite com facilidade, mas… “Você disse que era a única que estava lá para mim. Como posso deixá-la ir?” Hã? O que é isso?! Lize poderá renunciar?!

description.en: After waking up as the cruel mother in one of her favorite dark fantasy books, Seriel Roperam makes it her mission to steer her adorable son, Kardiciel, away from his future as the story's twisted male lead. However, her prior cold actions have left Kardiciel and her husband, Erykian, wary of her. After an initial awkward phase where neither of them believed her, the three of them slowly learn to rely on and trust one another. Will this once-dysfunctional family finally find their happy ending, or have Seriel's past actions left wounds too deep to heal?
description.fr: Je suis devenue la mère du méchant de l'histoire que je lisais avant de mourir? En voyant le personnage «méchant» qui n'est pour l'instant qu'un enfant innocent, j'ai décidé de l'élever «correctement» pour éviter une fin tragique pour nous tous. Cependant, cet objectif ne semble pas aussi facile à atteindre...
description.id: Ketika aku membuka mata, aku menyadari bahwa aku telah menjadi tokoh novel berjudul "Sayap yang Robek"! Kini aku harus menjalani hidup sebagai Sherryl, ibu dari tokoh utama yang terkenal kejam, Cartischel. Untungnya, aku masih punya waktu untuk mengubah masa depan. Aku gemetar memikirkan anakku di masa depan... tapi saat masih bocah begini, Cartischel terlalu lucu dan menggemaskan! Tidak mungkin aku membiarkan anak yang imut ini tumbuh menjadi seseorang yang mengurung dan menyakiti tokoh utama wanita, kan?
description.ko:
눈을 떠보니 피도 눈물도 없는 피폐물 소설 속 남주의 엄마 ‘셰리엘’이 되었다. 
원작 소설 속, 잔인하기로 유명한 남주 카르디셀이었기에  
싹수부터 다를 거라고 덜덜 떨며 그를 봤는데, 이게 웬걸? 

머지않아 피폐물 남주가 될 내 아들이 너무 귀엽다. 

“이렇게 귀여운 아이가 여주를 감금하고 해치는 사람으로 자라게 할 수 없어!”
description.th: พอลืมตาขึ้นมา ฉันกลับกลายเป็นแม่พระเอกนิยายจอมเสเพลไปซะแล้ว เพราะเขาคือพระเอกที่โด่งดังด้านความโหดร้ายในนิยายต้นฉบับ เคยมองเขาอย่าง อย่างตื่นเต้นและคงไม่แตกต่างอะไร 'อร่อยจัง!' แก้มที่เพลิดเพลินไปกับการกินขนมหวานนั้นกลมดิ๊ก 'ไม่เป็นไร ผมเดินไปได้!' ฉันได้เห็นภาพที่ต่อให้เขาล้มจนเจ็บตัว ก็เช็ดน้ำตาแล้วลุกเดินไปอีกครั้งอย่างมั่นใจได้ 'ทำยังไงดี...' ลูกชายที่จะกลายเป็นพระเอกนิยายจอมเสเพลช่างน่ารักจริง ๆ หลังจากนั้นฉันก็แอบเตรียมอะไรให้เขากิน เอาใจใส่ และเขียนจดหมายให้เขา ทว่า "ไม่ต้องมาใจดีกับผม! ถึงทำแบบนั้นไปผมก็ไม่ต้องการแม่อยู่ดี!" ดูเหมือนว่าลูกชายจะไม่ชอบฉันมากกว่าที่คิด
description.uk:
Я стала Шеріелю, матір'ю головного героя роману "Пустка без крові та сліз". В оригінальному романі головний герой, Кардісель, був відомий своєю жорстокістю, тому я дивилася на нього з трепетом і очікувала на людину про яку читала, але що ж це? Мій син, який незабаром стане головним героєм, такий милий.

З 1 по 26 розділи редагуються!!

"Ми не можемо дозволити, щоб така мила дитина виросла людиною, яка ув'язнює і завдає шкоди головній героїні!"
description.zh:
我的孩子是变态？！
乖宝宝养成计划启动!
在我睁开眼睛时，成为了冷血无情的虐心小说男主的妈妈“谢丽尔”。原作小说中，他是以残忍闻名的男主卡尔迪斯，因此我以为他一定是从小就残忍，所以十分害怕地看向了他。可这是怎么回事？我这个不久后会成为虐心小说男主的儿子实在是太可爱了。“不能让这么可爱的孩子长成囚禁并伤害女主的人!”
description.pt-br:
Quando abri os olhos, me tornei Sheriel, a mãe do protagonista masculino do romance "Asas rasgadas". No romance original, o protagonista masculino, Cardisel, era famoso por ser cruel, então olhei para ele com receio, pensando que ele seria diferente desde o início, mas o que foi isso? Meu filho, que em breve se tornará o protagonista masculino, é tão fofo.

“Não podemos deixar uma criança tão fofa crescer e se tornar uma pessoa que aprisiona e prejudica a protagonista feminina!”

"Ми не можемо дозволити, щоб така мила дитина виросла людиною, яка ув'язнює і завдає шкоди головній героїні!"
description.zh:
我的孩子是变态？！
乖宝宝养成计划启动!
在我睁开眼睛时，成为了冷血无情的虐心小说男主的妈妈“谢丽尔”。原作小说中，他是以残忍闻名的男主卡尔迪斯，因此我以为他一定是从小就残忍，所以十分害怕地看向了他。可这是怎么回事？我这个不久后会成为虐心小说男主的儿子实在是太可爱了。“不能让这么可爱的孩子长成囚禁并伤害女主的人!”
description.pt-br:
Quando abri os olhos, me tornei Sheriel, a mãe do protagonista masculino do romance "Asas rasgadas". No romance original, o protagonista masculino, Cardisel, era famoso por ser cruel, então olhei para ele com receio, pensando que ele seria diferente desde o início, mas o que foi isso? Meu filho, que em breve se tornará o protagonista masculino, é tão fofo.

“Não podemos deixar uma criança tão fofa crescer e se tornar uma pessoa que aprisiona e prejudica a protagonista feminina!”

description.ko:
눈을 떠보니 피도 눈물도 없는 피폐물 소설 속 남주의 엄마 ‘셰리엘’이 되었다. 
원작 소설 속, 잔인하기로 유명한 남주 카르디셀이었기에  
싹수부터 다를 거라고 덜덜 떨며 그를 봤는데, 이게 웬걸? 

머지않아 피폐물 남주가 될 내 아들이 너무 귀엽다. 

“이렇게 귀여운 아이가 여주를 감금하고 해치는 사람으로 자라게 할 수 없어!”
description.th: พอลืมตาขึ้นมา ฉันกลับกลายเป็นแม่พระเอกนิยายจอมเสเพลไปซะแล้ว เพราะเขาคือพระเอกที่โด่งดังด้านความโหดร้ายในนิยายต้นฉบับ เคยมองเขาอย่าง อย่างตื่นเต้นและคงไม่แตกต่างอะไร 'อร่อยจัง!' แก้มที่เพลิดเพลินไปกับการกินขนมหวานนั้นกลมดิ๊ก 'ไม่เป็นไร ผมเดินไปได้!' ฉันได้เห็นภาพที่ต่อให้เขาล้มจนเจ็บตัว ก็เช็ดน้ำตาแล้วลุกเดินไปอีกครั้งอย่างมั่นใจได้ 'ทำยังไงดี...' ลูกชายที่จะกลายเป็นพระเอกนิยายจอมเสเพลช่างน่ารักจริง ๆ หลังจากนั้นฉันก็แอบเตรียมอะไรให้เขากิน เอาใจใส่ และเขียนจดหมายให้เขา ทว่า "ไม่ต้องมาใจดีกับผม! ถึงทำแบบนั้นไปผมก็ไม่ต้องการแม่อยู่ดี!" ดูเหมือนว่าลูกชายจะไม่ชอบฉันมากกว่าที่คิด
description.uk:
Я стала Шеріелю, матір'ю головного героя роману "Пустка без крові та сліз". В оригінальному романі головний герой, Кардісель, був відомий своєю жорстокістю, тому я дивилася на нього з трепетом і очікувала на людину про яку читала, але що ж це? Мій син, який незабаром стане головним героєм, такий милий.

З 1 по 26 розділи редагуються!!

"Ми не можемо дозволити, щоб така мила дитина виросла людиною, яка ув'язнює і завдає шкоди головній героїні!"
